==50%==
Once you’ve taken the opposite of each word below, the phrase becomes a famous one. Which of these completes it?
{| class="fandom-table"
! colspan="3" |Subtract compliment from...
|-
|Milk
|Storm
|'''Injury'''
|}
The famous phrase is ‘Add insult to injury’. The opposite of ‘subtract’ is ‘add’. The opposite of ‘compliment’ is ‘insult’ and the opposite of ‘from’ is ‘to’ so ‘injury’ completes the phrase.

==30%==
These words all have something in common. Which of the following words could also be included in the list?
{| class="fandom-table"
! colspan="3" |Soak Sash Spine Steak
|-
|Bath
|Drop
|'''Helm'''
|}
If you remove the first letter, you get the name of a tree – oak, ash, pine and teak. Remove the H from Helm and you get ‘elm’.
